# tools/level/check.py

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Checks the open level .blend against the rules (rules.py) and the kit
against the metrics; exits 1 naming each problem.

    Blender -b assets/level/source/<level>.blend --python tools/level/check.py [-- stage2]

## Functions

### check

```python
def check(stage='stage1')
```

[Source:17](../../../../../tools/level/check.py#L17)

Return (level_dict, list[str] failures) for the open Blender scene.

stage is 'stage1' or 'stage2'. Prints all rule failures and a summary;
[] means valid. This function does not exit; the CLI exits 1 on failures.
